background: Three-module Python catalog API has pagination and filtering defects.
purpose: Return correct catalog pages without breaking public function signatures.
objective: Repair query parsing, pagination, and catalog filtering as one change. Preserve public signatures and return keys; no dependencies. Validate positive integer pagination (reject bool/floats), filter active records before sorting/paging, report filtered total, and never mutate inputs. Inspect relevant code, implement, run registered tests and repair within the task budget. Stop if broader API changes are required.
acceptance: Query values accept positive ints or stripped ASCII decimal strings; None uses defaults. Invalid values raise ValueError. Size is capped at maximum.
paginate takes positive integer page and size, rejects bool/floats; one-based slicing, accurate total and has_next, empty and out-of-range pages work.
list_catalog filters inactive rows before paging, sorts by id, reports active total, does not mutate records or params.
Keep existing public signatures and response keys. Change only the three allowed implementation files; do not change tests or add dependencies. All 15 tests pass.
